cohort: 143 women with ectopic pregnancy diagnosed and corroborated with histopathological study at Hospital Angeles del Pedregal from 2006 to 2012.
finding: The average age of women with ectopic pregnancies was 32.4 years, with 89% over 25 years old; risk factors included primigravida (35%), previous caesarean (36%), abortion (22%), childbirth (15%), history of ectopic pregnancy (10%), gestational age of 5 weeks (39%), lack of contraceptive use (72%), smoking (30%), and pelvic inflammatory disease (2%).
